channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Short daily digest of tech opinions and blog posts

item.title: Bruce Schneier: Hiding Capabilities in AI Models
item.description: New research shows models can provably hide arbitrary capabilities behind encrypted triggers — elicitation-based capability audits have a hard limit, even with full access to the weights.

item.title: Ben Recht: The World Is Something We Make
item.description: Against Anthropic S-1 inevitability: a truly open language model — weights, code, data and process, not just open weights — is necessary and more buildable than it looks; the hard part is shared compute, not technology.

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Anthropic Versus Anthropic
item.description: Zvi reads Dario Amodei's full point-by-point reply to Nathan Calvin over the leaked draft bill: real, costly safety sacrifices on one side, a policy operation still short of the moment on the other.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: History is something you do
item.description: Doctorow argues prediction is a helpless posture — sf at its best is Luddite in the original sense: insisting humans choose who technology serves, rather than tying themselves to the tracks of an 'inevitable' future.
